force_envelope.scope: Conservative local actuator bracket screen. Internal rod forces are not treated as whole-robot ground forces. Real impacts can exceed commanded motor torque.

load_envelope.ground_cases: One kilogram payload, single support at 1 g; unloaded two-foot support at 3 g. Horizontal ground forces independently ±30% of vertical.
load_envelope.section_loading: Ideal knee shaft transmits force and X/Z overturning moment; its free Y rotation carries no bearing torque. Shaft loads include independent ±17 Nm actuator rod force. Unsymmetric bending uses the full area-moment tensor.
load_envelope.scope: Independent conservative force envelope, not a dynamically consistent gait simulation. Normal stress only; torsional/shear stress, local bearing/pin stresses, joint flexibility and fatigue remain unqualified.

unverified: Actuator output-bearing radial and overturning ratings
Material allowables at print direction and operating temperature

connection_assumption.section: Combined-half properties assume full composite action. That connection has not been qualified.
connection_assumption.seam_shear: Reported shear flow is a local prismatic-beam requirement. Closure sleeves can bypass the printed faces; bolt torque alone does not establish seam pressure or friction capacity.
connection_assumption.scope: Local pad bearing/punching, thread engagement, plate prying, hole-clearance slip and tolerance stack need separate qualification.

clearance_allowance_example.scope: Example budget only. Actual purchased dimensions, process capability and loaded deflection remain unmeasured.

section_method: Planar cuts through welded exported meshes; polygon area moments by Green theorem. Source tessellation tolerance 0.1 mm; candidate 0.08 mm. This is a gross-section comparison, not FEA.
scope: Gross section area moments describe stiffness-related geometry only. They omit fastener slip, open-shell torsion, stress concentrations, print anisotropy, creep, heat, fatigue and impacts. Hole surrounds establish geometric ligaments, not bolt or material strength. New mounts and slimmer shells require load and fatigue qualification.
